title: Knockback
wikitext:
{{about|the game mechanic|the support gem|Knockback Support}}

'''Knockback''' is an on-[[hit]] effect that slightly pushes targets away from the attacker. Unlike a [[stun]], a knockback does not interrupt the target's actions.<ref name="KnockbackMove"/>

==Mechanics==
Knockback has a minimum knockback distance of 0.4 metres. Knockback occurs at a rate of 3.75 metres/second<ref>https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/1718488/page/2#p13620526</ref>. The movement from knockback is not affected by [[action speed]] or movement speed modifiers.

Knockback direction is skill dependent but is generally away from the thing (not necessarily the player) doing the hit. Projectiles knockback targets in the direction the projectile is travelling meaning returning projectiles could knockback enemies back towards the attacker on the way back. However, some area projectile based skills like Ball Lightning / Rolling Magma knockback enemies away from the centre of the projectile as they travel.<ref name="KnockbackMechanicsReport"/>

Being knocked back counts as moving, and the target will suffer the increased [[damage over time]] from [[bleed]] while being knocked back.

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.20.1b|
* Fixed a bug with the knockback from Kinetic Blast not going in the correct direction away from blasts.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.12.4b|
* Fixed a bug introduced in 3.12.4 where the "Knockback direction is reversed" modifier on Empire's Grasp unique gloves didn't work.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.12.4|
* Divergent Heavy Strike (whose quality grants reduced Knockback Distance) can no longer cause enemies to be pulled towards you when the gem has greater than 20% quality. At 20% quality, the skill will not provide any Knockback effect.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.11.0|
* The base distance an enemy is knocked back by knockback effects is now based on the enemy's size. Smaller enemies are knocked farther back than large enemies.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.8.1|
* Changed knockback passives to be knockback-on-crit.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.7.1|
* Implemented knockback.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
